prompt: A photorealistic photo captures a bustling pottery workshop scene. On the left, a woman in a blue apron sits on a wooden stool, her hands covered in wet clay as she shapes a bowl on the spinning wheel. In the center, a tall man with glasses stands beside her, pointing at the rotating clay form to offer guidance. To the right, a young girl with pigtails watches intently, holding a small sponge ready to assist. Next to the girl, a gray cat sleeps peacefully on a stack of finished terracotta pots, its tail curled around its body. Behind them, an elderly man in a beige hat looks at a shelf of dried vases, inspecting the craftsmanship. The woman is handing a tool to the man with glasses, who reaches out to accept it. The girl is looking at the cat, observing its calm demeanor. There is no electric kiln visible in the background, keeping the focus on traditional hand-building techniques and natural materials within the rustic space.
